records.name: St. Matthew Catholic Church
records.address: 8200 Robert E. Lee Drive, Spotsylvania, VA 22551

score_notes.gender: Male-only priesthood.
score_notes.leadership: Male clergy with deacons.
score_notes.soteriology: Roman Catholic soteriology — Council of Trent (1547) anathematized justification by faith alone; salvation is faith + works + sacraments (Eucharist, confession, penance, purgatory, indulgences). This is a fundamental break with the Reformation gospel and therefore with the MOOP rubric's sola fide requirement. Orthodox Trinitarian Christology and male-only priests are preserved, but the gospel itself is modified.
score_notes.mission: Youth ministry, adult education, extensive outreach.
